title: Machine pairing, status and confirmed execution
description: Requesting a one-time active-mode computer pairing link, checking computer connection status, and running owner-confirmed commands from an extension (#12798, #16741): machines.pair_link requires machines.pair in permissions.hub (always creates or re-issues for a pending link computer, which still requires the owner's confirmation), machines.status requires machines.read or machines.pair, and machines.exec requires machines.exec (granted by name only; every call requires an explicit owner confirmation card before reaching the computer). Params are strict: an unknown field is invalid_params. Plugin-side: only the hub and the program speak it.

MachinesPairLinkParams.description: machines.pair_link (machines.pair): request a one-time persona://link?... pairing link for a pending link computer.

machine_id.description: Optional computer id: re-issues a pairing link when an existing pending link machine matches (with name/os/icon omitted), or creates a new pending link machine with this id (defaulting name to machine_id when name is omitted).

name.description: Display name for a newly added computer (defaults to machine_id when machine_id is given; required when machine_id is omitted).

os.description: Target OS hint for install commands.

machine_id.description: The hub machine id assigned to the computer.

name.description: The display name of the computer.

pending.description: Whether the computer is waiting for the owner's confirmation.

install_linux.description: Optional one-line Linux install-and-pair command when the hub knows its publication site.

MachinesStatusParams.description: machines.status (machines.read or machines.pair): read one computer's current connection and confirmation state.

online.description: Whether the computer's link/connection is currently up.

node_online.description: Whether the resident node is connected and responding.

pending.description: Whether the computer is waiting for the owner's confirmation.

last_seen.description: When the computer was last seen online, if ever.

MachinesExecParams.description: machines.exec (machines.exec): run one command on a confirmed, online computer after the owner approves it on a confirmation card. Provide exactly one of argv (direct exec without shell) or command (run via /bin/sh -c).

argv.description: Direct executable and arguments without a shell (mutually exclusive with command; at most 64 items, total <= 4096 bytes, no NUL bytes).

command.description: Shell command executed via /bin/sh -c (mutually exclusive with argv; at most 1024 characters, no NUL bytes).

cwd.description: Optional working directory on the computer.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum combined stdout and stderr bytes to return (default 16384, max 65536).

reason.description: Optional human-readable explanation shown on the owner confirmation card.

output.description: Combined stdout and stderr, safely truncated to max_output_bytes when needed.

truncated.description: Whether output exceeded max_output_bytes and was truncated.
